content: The elementary system Segmenter$_{\mu }$ (baseline) relies solely on a list of discursive markers to perform the segmentation. It replaces the appearance of a marker in the list with a special symbol, for example $\mu $, which indicates a boundary between the right and left segment. Be the sentence of the preceding example: La ville d'Avignon est la capitale du Vaucluse, qui est un département du Sud de la France.. The Segmenter split the sentence in two parts: the left segment (SE), La ville d'Avignon est la capitale du Vaucluse, and the right segment (SD), est un département du sud de la France.
